parent.title: A weekend in Oslo, anchored on a Michelin dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in Oslo
siblings.summary: What to actually do across an Oslo weekend in late May 2026, with the Michelin dinner already booked: do two things on the water, pick two indoors, skip what looks obligatory but isn't.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events in Oslo
siblings.summary: Oslo's 2026 tech calendar at a glance — flagship conferences (NDC, JavaZone, NIC, Y Oslo), Innovation Week, plus recurring meetups, with hotel-impact warnings for trip planners.

sources.title: List of Michelin-starred restaurants in Norway — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Maaemo holds 3 Michelin stars and Kontrast holds 2 Michelin stars; Kontrast was upgraded from 1 to 2 in 2024.

sources.title: Maaemo — Visit Oslo
sources.claim: Maaemo is Oslo's only restaurant with three stars in the Michelin Guide and also holds a Green Star.

sources.title: Maaemo — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Maaemo opened December 2010, received 2 stars March 2012, 3 stars February 2016, lost all stars 2020, regained 3 stars Sept 2021.

sources.title: Esben Holmboe Bang — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Esben Holmboe Bang is the Danish-Norwegian chef-owner who leads Maaemo's kitchen.

sources.title: Maaemo (official site)
sources.claim: Maaemo accepts reservations via Exploretock — the restaurant's primary booking channel.

sources.title: Maaemo on Tock
sources.claim: Maaemo books on Tock and releases tables on a fixed monthly schedule.

sources.title: Maaemo booking window — TripAdvisor FAQ
sources.claim: Maaemo releases reservations on the 1st of each month at 12:00 CET, opening tables roughly two months ahead.

sources.title: Maaemo — OAD Guides
sources.claim: Maaemo is at Dronning Eufemias gate 23, 0194 Oslo, in Bjørvika near the Opera House.

sources.title: Maaemo — Top 25 Restaurants
sources.claim: Maaemo serves a set tasting menu of 20+ dishes priced at NOK 4,500.

sources.title: Maaemo: Norway's only 3-star — CNN Travel
sources.claim: Maaemo's menu is built on Norwegian seasonal, organic, biodynamic and wild ingredients.

sources.title: Kontrast — Michelin Guide article
sources.claim: Kontrast holds two Michelin stars and a Green Star; ~98% of its produce is sourced locally.

sources.title: Kontrast (official site)
sources.claim: Kontrast is at Maridalsveien 15, 0175 Oslo and books via its own online system.

sources.title: Mikael Svensson profile — Image.ie
sources.claim: Mikael Svensson grew up in Skåne; co-founded b.culture in 2020 to upcycle Kontrast's byproducts.

sources.title: Kontrast — World's 50 Best Discovery
sources.claim: Kontrast occupies the Vulkan development with stark interiors and an industrial edge.

sources.title: Kontrast — Eat Week Guide
sources.claim: Kontrast opened in 2013, first star 2016, promoted to two stars 2024.

sources.title: Oslo best restaurants 2026 — Restaurants for Kings
sources.claim: Kontrast's Big Kontrasts tasting menu runs NOK 2,300; wine pairing NOK 1,700 / 2,450 / 945 alc-free.

sources.title: Maaemo — World's 50 Best Discovery
sources.claim: Maaemo's room is strikingly minimalist, in an industrial setting close to Oslo's old dock.

sources.title: Maaemo — RestaurantGuru
sources.claim: Maaemo serves dinner Tuesday through Saturday, 18:00–24:00.
